priority_zero.operation: Reuse archived sustained-smooth empty-grasp RGB/encoders/receipts first; run unchanged public feature extraction before opening evaluation truth.
priority_zero.purpose: Add already-available closed-empty target-supported data to the evidence table without falsely calling early open-gripper frames a hard negative.
priority_zero.limitation: Different arm posture, commands and target relation from successful carry; not a matched discrimination experiment. No threshold fitting or automatic handoff follows.

reuse_positive.purpose: Locked carrying movement reference under feedforward; no repeat of the 3.19 mm control experiment.

reuse_supported.limitation: One supported/drop trajectory, still finger-contacting; no independently matched lateral Transport observation.

branch_semantics.name: closed_empty_motion_negative
branch_semantics.start_source: An explicitly registered archived no-target-finger-contact full integration snapshot, preferably sustained-smooth final state; no object teleport or hidden support.
branch_semantics.control: Preserve its own actual clamp target. A source-specific bounded lateral diagnostic path must be statically planned and protected beforehand; do not apply successful-carry joint commands blindly to this different posture.

branch_semantics.name: supported_target_motion_negative
branch_semantics.start_source: An explicitly registered archived handoff-wait supported full integration snapshot; retention/support is an offline starting hypothesis only.
branch_semantics.control: Preserve its actual clamp target, prohibit release, use one pre-registered source-specific bounded motion. If support changes during motion, retain the transition as evaluation outcome rather than forcing the label.

new_data_only_if_archived_coverage_remai.authorization_gate: This is a data-collection proposal, not executable registration. Verify exact saved-state, nominal commands, geometry, owner, finite permission and protection fingerprints before seeking one explicit approval. No execution this turn.
new_data_only_if_archived_coverage_remai.purpose: A small hard-negative screen. Two local episodes cannot validate general carry recognition or calibrate reliable release permissions.

association_failures.first_step: Build at most 6 archived-data software counterfactual pairs: missing front frame, missing wrist frame, stale timestamp, cross-time inconsistent camera pair, incompatible region assignment, duplicated/ambiguous regional association. Mark every pair synthetic and retain its original image provenance.
association_failures.claim_allowed: Only invalid/contradictory input rejection; no claim of real-scene association robustness.
association_failures.real_collection_missing: A real wrong-object/occlusion/conflict condition needs a separately registered observable scene change. Do not invent its coordinates or silently execute black-block perturbation.

data_firewall.order: Freeze and hash public feature table first. Evaluate private contact/support/object movement in a separate evaluator afterwards. Do not write labels back into the online verifier.
data_firewall.split: Group samples by original trajectory/branch, not by individual frames. Shared start state, shared prefix and repeated captures remain correlated.
data_firewall.output: Report observed/unknown and contradictions separately. No tuned residual threshold, subjective carry score or privilege escalation.

release_interfaces.pre_release_support: Object demonstrably supported before opening; not supplied by reaching an EE endpoint or descent receipt.
release_interfaces.post_release_placement: After an actual release receipt, target stays in registered region and gripper withdraws; separate from pre-release permission.
release_interfaces.current_status: Both unknown; automatic Transport handoff and Place release remain closed. This carry screen does not collect cell_0 support/release examples.
